property.name: Audiences
property.summary: Normalized requested audiences copied from the access request.

property.name: Credential
property.summary: Normalized presented credential copied from the access request.

property.name: ExternalRequest
property.summary: True when the request was explicitly marked as external.

property.name: HostMatched
property.summary: True when the request's host relationship matched the current tool context.

property.name: Lifetime
property.summary: Normalized requested lifetime copied from the access request.

property.name: ManagementCredentialValid
property.summary: True when the request carried a management credential recognized by the current tool context.

property.name: Operations
property.summary: Normalized requested protected operations copied from the access request.

property.name: Properties
property.summary: Normalized request properties copied from the access request.

property.name: RequestedAssertions
property.summary: Normalized requested assertions copied from the access request.

property.name: RequestedKeyType
property.summary: Canonical requested key-type token for policy and issuance dispatch.

property.name: RequestValidated
property.summary: True when the request passed the manager's normalization and baseline validation checks.

property.name: Scopes
property.summary: Normalized requested scopes copied from the access request.

property.name: ServiceMatched
property.summary: True when the request targeted the current tool as the requested service.

property.name: Subject
property.summary: Normalized request subject for policy and issuance use.
